replacement_policy: Input batches are ordered oldest to newest. Every later complete five-round shape replaces its entire earlier row, regardless of latency. No cross-batch minimum is selected.
external_reference_policy: Finalist batches select their fastest valid external candidate from the <=5% finalist set established by the same-GPU successful full87 sweep, which enumerated CK/CKTile/ASM. A finalist run does not repeat a complete external sweep. Full-mode input batches, if supplied, use all their valid external candidates.
comparison_policy: Best valid registered/experimental OPUS versus the same shape/GPU/batch external reference; old OPUS is the fastest of 9000/9010/9011/9012/9020 in that same batch.
aggregation_policy: Geometric means use per-shape latency ratios, never absolute latencies pooled across shapes or GPUs. Five-round wins are paired against that batch's median-selected external reference.
scope_limit: Original 87 targets only; no change to the historical complete-295 baseline.
